WorkflowOperations.title: Automation operations
WorkflowOperations.description: See what is healthy, what is waiting, and where a person needs to step in.

access.title: Workflow access required
access.body: You do not have permission to manage automation in this workspace.

errors.title: Automation operations could not be loaded
errors.body: No metrics have been assumed. Try loading the current operational state again.
errors.mutationBody: The loaded evidence remains available. Refresh it before deciding whether to try the operation again.

triggerDiagnostics.title: Trigger delivery needs attention
triggerDiagnostics.description: These triggers failed before record enrollment. The fixed diagnostic code remains visible until a later delivery succeeds.
triggerDiagnostics.outcome: No run was started for this {triggerType} trigger.

runs.title: Recent runs
runs.description: Canonical and migrated history use explicit run keys, so their identifiers are never confused.
runs.emptyBody: Change the status or failure filter to review other automation history.

detail.missingBody: This run key does not exist in this workspace or is no longer visible to you.
detail.retryDistinctionTitle: Retry and new run are different operations
detail.retryDistinctionBody: Retry resumes the current failed action against its pinned version. A new run enrolls a record against the current active version.

path.title: Executed path
path.description: Each row is stored evidence for one node outcome. No step is inferred from notifications.
path.legacyBody: Migrated legacy runs do not have canonical step rows, so Connex does not invent a path for them.

signal.intake_paused: New intake is paused while the backlog is preserved.
signal.workflow_disabled: New runs are disabled. In-flight work continues.
signal.workflow_archived: The workflow is archived and retains its history.
signal.open_intervention: At least one run needs a person to intervene.
signal.queued_backlog: Runs are waiting in the execution queue.
signal.waiting_backlog: Runs are waiting for a delay to finish.
signal.overdue_backlog: At least one queued or waiting run is overdue.

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.recentFailures: {count, plural, =0 {No recent failures} one {# recent failure} other {# recent failures}}

changes.title: Recent definition changes
changes.description: Immutable published versions show how the path changed over time.
changes.empty: No published version changes are available.

controls.title: Operational controls
controls.pauseHelp: Pause holds new intake and preserves its backlog.
controls.disableHelp: Disable stops new runs while in-flight runs continue. Archive remains a separate product action.

reason.actor_inactive: The configured actor is no longer active.
reason.permission_denied: The caller no longer has permission for this operation.
reason.action_permission_missing: The action actor is missing a required permission.
reason.record_unavailable: The target record is unavailable or not visible.
reason.retry_exhausted: The bounded retry limit was reached.
reason.retry_not_safe: This action is not classified as retry-safe.
reason.unknown: A support-safe diagnostic is available, but no localized detail is defined for this client version.

manual.title: Run workflow
manual.description: Freeze an exact record scope, review it, then confirm one durable invocation.
manual.distinctionBody: This is separate from retrying a failed action. The selected workflow uses its current active version.
manual.noWorkflows: No published canonical workflow matches this record type.

scope.page_selection: {count, plural, one {# selected record} other {# selected records}}
scope.explicit_selection: {count, plural, one {# explicitly selected record} other {# explicitly selected records}}
scope.filter_match: All records matching the server-resolved filter
scope.smart_segment: All records matching the smart segment
scope.saved_view: All records in the saved view
scope.search_snapshot: All records in the search snapshot
scope.command_palette: Command palette scope with a resolved nested scope

manual.confirmedBody: Connex accepted the frozen scope of {count, plural, one {# record} other {# records}}.
manual.partialNote: Some records were skipped or failed. The per-record result remains attached to this invocation.
manual.moreRecordIssues: {count, plural, one {# more record is retained in the invocation} other {# more records are retained in the invocation}}.

errors.title: The run could not be prepared
errors.prepare: The exact scope could not be frozen. Review the workflow and scope, then try again.
errors.confirm: The scope may have expired or changed. Prepare it again before confirming.
errors.result: The current invocation result could not be loaded.
errors.cancel: The remaining invocation records could not be cancelled.

blocker.workflow_not_canonical: The canonical runtime does not own this workflow.
blocker.scope_hash_mismatch: The prepared scope no longer matches its confirmation hash.
blocker.record_not_visible: At least one record is not visible to the current caller.
blocker.record_not_found: At least one record no longer exists.
blocker.record_type_mismatch: The scope contains a different record type.
blocker.scope_too_large: The exact scope exceeds the 1,000-record limit.
blocker.scope_empty: The exact scope contains no records.
blocker.scope_not_supported: This scope is not supported for the selected workflow.
blocker.nested_command_scope: A command palette scope cannot contain another command palette scope.
blocker.action_permission_missing: The action actor is missing a required permission.
blocker.definition_invalid: The active workflow definition is invalid.

recipes.title: Workflow recipes
recipes.description: Start from three deterministic patterns with every actor, permission, data touch, and side effect disclosed.
recipes.emptyBody: The curated recipe register is currently empty.
recipes.errorBody: Try loading the curated register again.
recipes.missingBody: This recipe key is not available in the current register.
recipes.configureBody: Editable values are applied to the deterministic template. Locked trigger and graph fields cannot be changed here.
recipes.exampleRecordHelp: When provided, preview evaluates one permission-visible record without running the workflow.
recipes.previewOnlyTitle: Preview only, no workflow will run
recipes.previewOnlyBody: Preview creates no workflow, version, run, step, outbox, audit, task, note, activity, tag, notification, or record mutation.
recipes.unresolved: {count, plural, one {# required value is unresolved} other {# required values are unresolved}}.
recipes.validationBlocked: The generated definition is not ready to publish.
recipes.installHelp: Installation creates a disabled canonical workflow with recipe and template version attribution. Enable it only after review.
recipes.actionErrorBody: No success has been assumed. Review the configuration and try again.
recipes.disclosureBody: These disclosures are part of the recipe contract and remain attributable after installation.
recipes.disableBehavior: Disable stops new runs while in-flight runs continue
recipes.removeBehavior: Remove archives the workflow and retains versions and run history

person-job-change-follow-up.title: Follow up after a job change
person-job-change-follow-up.description: When a contact's employment changes, create a bounded follow-up task for the configured owner.

deal-won-handoff.title: Hand off a won deal
deal-won-handoff.description: When a deal is won, log the handoff context and create a follow-up task for the configured owner.

cooling-company-review.title: Review a cooling company
cooling-company-review.description: On a schedule, enroll companies that meet the cooling predicate and create a review task.
